aws_launch_template.managed_node_groups explicitly depends on the IAM role, but it also depends on aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.managed_ng, which itself depends on that role. The direct depends_on edge is already implied transitively.

aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng explicitly depends on the IAM role, but its launch-template input depends on the instance profile, which itself depends on that role. The direct dependency is already implied transitively.
aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng explicitly depends on the instance profile, but its launch-template input already references that profile, establishing the dependency transitively.

null_resource.update_trust_policy references the namespace in its local-exec command, so the explicit dependency on that namespace duplicates the implicit reference dependency.
